description: Start the art style transfer workflow: restyle an owned image in a selected art style. First call chargen_quote_recipe_art_style_transfer, confirm its Gold price with the user, then pass the quote_token here with the same values. Eligible reference sheets can be free; other runs spend the quoted Gold. Returns request_id; poll chargen_get_job for all output images. For input rules, use chargen_get_recipe_art_style_transfer. An identical call within about 10 minutes returns the earlier request instead of charging again; pass a new idempotency_key when the user wants another take with the same settings.

idempotency_key.description: Optional retry key (letters, numbers, - and _). Reusing it returns the same request without a new charge; a new key makes a new take with the same settings.

quote_token.description: Approved quote_token from chargen_quote_recipe_art_style_transfer. Changed inputs or pricing fail without charging.

sourceImageId.description: Owned still image UUID from chargen_search_gallery

name: chargen_run_recipe_art_style_transfer
title: Run art style transfer
